text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black decides not to run in the Japanese Derby and simply observes it. There, she witnesses Brusquement's record-breaking victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon seeing Brusquement's powerful final acceleration, Kitasan Black is struck by a chilling realization that the moment you exhaust your stamina is the moment you lose in medium and long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she has no affinity for long-distance races, then the 3,000-meter fall Kikuka Sho will be a nightmare. A new problem has reared its ugly head.
